text: In this month our record was one document, repeated. Seventy-one of us said "national defense authorization"; seventy of us said "national defense authorization act"; fifty-one said "defense authorization act ndaa." Each peaked on the same day, 2019-07-12. Fifty of us reached "the national defense authorization act ndaa," thirty-two of us "the national defense authorization act ndaa" in its longer form. All of these first entered the record on 2013-01-03, first said by M001166. "The national defense" also numbered fifty-one of us, first said by Michael F. Bennet. Later, on 2019-07-23, thirty-one of us said "secretary of defense." We converged on the name of a bill and held it. That is what the record shows of us this month: one act, said many ways, by many of us, at once.
